ruleSummary: Nearest ASOS/METAR-style NWS station with same state and WFO as the place; summit slot only within 20 km when station elevation is within 900 ft of catalog summit elevation (or higher). Optional valley slot is the nearest qualifying station at least 700 ft lower (up to 95 km). Manual summit pins for KMWN and MMNV1. MMNV1 is shown only in the Mansfield pack, not duplicated here. Places with no qualifying station within radius have no observation block.
